name: grobbulus
_comment: Fully Level-2 port of the C++ Grobbulus strategy (see BossNotes/Grobbulus.md). Single-phase, purely positional. Uses orbit_point 'interval' (stepped kite), self_aura gating (Mutating Injection), and position_vs_boss. The off-tank Fallout Slime rule is an addition beyond C++ -- delete it for a pure 1:1 port. Test 25-man.

rules._comment: Main-tank kite: stepped orbit around room center, advancing one waypoint per ~15s (one drag per Poison Cloud) so the tank parks and refreshes threat between drags. (Drop 'interval' for a continuous kite.)
Mutating Injection on a melee/tank (role melee,tank = !IsRanged): back off >=18y in any direction so the explosion cloud lands in open ground. only_if_closer yields once already out of range.
Mutating Injection on a ranged/healer: run 24y behind the boss to drop the cloud away from the stack.
Ranged/healer without injection (the default ranged position): re-stack at room center; yields once within 5y so they DPS/heal.
Addition (not in the C++ strategy): off-tank herds Fallout Slimes (16290) onto the boss for cleave. Bot-only slot. DELETE for a pure 1:1 port.

suppress._comment: GrobbulusMultiplier part 1: zero 'avoid aoe' for the main tank only, so it keeps dragging the boss through the Poison Clouds it kites (lets orbit_point @3 win the tick). 'reach melee' left alone so the tank stays in melee.
GrobbulusMultiplier part 2: zero formation-follow for all bots while engaged (it would re-pull bots toward the master and fight the injection-spread / re-center movement).
